description: This file declares the USBDevice class, which implements plugin and JSON-RPC interfaces for USB device management, including notification handling for device plug-in and plug-out events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device plugin implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing device notifications and lifecycle.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Handles remote connection and USB device notifications, forwarding device plug-in and plug-out events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.
